title: WooCommerce Optimization
description: Performance and checkout optimization checklist for WooCommerce stores.

steps.title: Configure Product Permalinks
steps.instructions: Set product permalink structure to /shop/ or category-based URLs.

steps.title: Optimize Cart Fragments
steps.instructions: Disable cart fragments on non-shop pages or defer loading for performance.

steps.title: Regenerate Product Images
steps.instructions: Regenerate WooCommerce thumbnail sizes after theme switch.

steps.title: Streamline Checkout
steps.instructions: Remove unnecessary checkout fields and enable guest checkout if appropriate.

steps.title: Configure Cache Exclusions
steps.instructions: Exclude cart, checkout, and my-account from full-page cache.
